description: Each week AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and others) and a coin flip pick which of two AI infrastructure stocks will have the higher price return over the week, locked before the first open and settled on price after the last close. Returns each label's wins, losses, ties, no-picks and hit rate for all time, the last 12 weeks or the last 4 weeks, with the coin flip as the baseline. Use when the question is which AI model picks stocks better, or how one model is doing. For one week's picks and reasoning use get_ai_matchup_week. Supercycle does not pick: the models do. Picks are AI-generated forecasts, not investment advice, and the models have no portfolios.

window.description: all: all time; 12w: last 12 weeks; 4w: last 4 weeks. Default all. A week counts once at least one of its pairs has settled.
